# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({                                                              # Suppress startup messages for cleaner logs
  library(dplyr)                                                                # For data manipulation
  library(Harman)                                                               # For batch correction
  library(SummarizedExperiment)                                                 # For handling SummarizedExperiment objects
  library(parallel)                                                             # For parallel processing backend
  library(doParallel)                                                           # For parallel processing with foreach
})                                                                              # End suppressMessages

base_dir <- "../../.."                                                          # Define project base directory relative to script location
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION")                # Define harmonization analysis directory
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "R")                                        # Define directory containing helper R scripts
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data_CN_only/preprocessing/FHS")           # Define directory for processed Framingham data

source(file.path(code_dir, "harman_functions.R"), local = TRUE)                 # source modifications to Harman functions
source(file.path(code_dir, "batch_functions.R"), local = TRUE)                  # source batch correction functions
```

# Load Data

```{r load}
dnam_data <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_imputed.RDS"))                   # Read normalized DNA methylation data
```

# Run Batch Correction

```{r batch}
batch_res <- batch_data(                                                        # Run batch correction
  dnam_data,                                                                    # Input SummarizedExperiment object
  batch_var = "Batch",                                                          # Column name for batch IDs
  expt_vars = "age_split_by_tertiles",                                          # Biological covariate to preserve
  max_pc = 750                                                                  # Max PCs for dimensionality reduction
)                                                                               # Returns list with Harman results

harman_data <- batch_res$harman_data                                            # Extract Harman object from results
use_full <- batch_res$use_full                                                  # Extract method flag (full vs adjusted)

correct_data <- reconstruct_data(dnam_data, harman_data, use_full = use_full)   # Reconstruct corrected beta values
```

# Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(dnam_data, file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_batched.RDS"))                     # Save final beta-value DNAm object
```
